candidates.change_summary: Replace `withdraw(address(this).balance)` with `withdraw(0)` so that `withdrawAll` transfers zero instead of the full balance.
Delete the `withdraw(address(this).balance);` statement so that `withdrawAll` does nothing.
Remove the `onlyOwner` modifier from `withdrawAll` so anyone can call it and change the contract balance.
Replace `require(msg.sender==owner)` with `require(true)` so any caller is authorized.
Delete the transfer statement so that withdraw sends no funds.
Replace msg.sender with address(0) so transfer sends funds to zero address instead of owner.
Replace _value with 0 so transfer sends zero wei.
Delete the require check so anyone can call onlyOwner functions.
Change require condition to msg.sender != owner so only non-owners can call guarded functions.
Remove the require statement that checks the return value of the low-level call, so sendMoney succeeds silently even when the call fails.
Replace the sendMoney body with a direct transfer to msg.sender instead of the specified target, changing who receives the funds.
Replace the sendMoney body with a code-less call that sends zero value regardless of the _value argument.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from sendMoney, allowing anyone to call it and alter its behavior when called by non-owner.
Change the onlyOwner modifier to always revert, making sendMoney (and other owner-only functions) inaccessible and thus changing sendMoney's observable behavior.
